Maruti Suzuki to Invest ₹77,500 Crore by FY31

Maruti Suzuki announced plans to invest approximately ₹77,500 crore by the fiscal year 2031. The investment is intended for capacity expansion and a revival of its small-car segment. The company's capital expenditure outlay has been increased to support these initiatives.
